name: Sequoia Adelaide Hills
positioning: Sequoia Lodge, a small luxury lodge with valley-view suites and spring-fed hot pools atop Mount Lofty in the Adelaide Hills, about 20 minutes by car from the Adelaide CBD
best_for: Couples wanting a nature retreat with valley views close to Adelaide
Travelers who want wellness, wildlife and Adelaide Hills food and wine experiences

facts.text: Sequoia Lodge sits atop Mount Lofty in the Adelaide Hills, affectionately known as Koala Mountain.
The lodge's 30-acre nature setting blends into the Adelaide Hills Botanic Gardens on one side of the peak and thousands of acres of national park on the other.
The lodge is about 20 minutes by car from the Adelaide CBD.
Each open-plan suite is perched on the edge of the Piccadilly Valley, with panoramic views from the sunken lounge, bedroom and bathroom.
Suites have a sunken lounge with a stone-clad gas fireplace.
Each suite has an east-facing panoramic balcony with an expansive daybed.
The suites were brought to life by local suppliers, craftsmen and artisans, with warm accents of wood and stone.
Guests have exclusive use of the lodge lounge, with multiple fireplaces, sunken lounges, 180-degree valley views and a panoramic sun deck.
Within the lodge grounds there are artesian spring-fed hot pools and an infinity pool.
Included on-site experiences change daily and seasonally, and include dreamtime stories, sunrise yoga and guided nature walks of the Mount Lofty Botanic Garden.
Gatekeeper's Day Spa sits in a cottage just outside the estate's historical entrance gate.
Guests can dine at the three-hatted Hardy's Verandah Restaurant on the neighbouring Mount Lofty Estate.

highlights.text: Artesian spring-fed hot pools overlook the Piccadilly Valley and are reserved exclusively for lodge guests.
A 150-year-old Sequoia tree stands at the centre of the lodge.
The Wellness Suite has a private screened wellness deck with a four-person cedar barrel sauna, its picture window framing the valley.
Guests can watch wallabies and kangaroos forage below the suite balconies.
Each suite features an original oil painting by resident artist Stephen Trebilcock, known for capturing local native florals.

considerations.text: Premium dining, Gatekeeper's Day Spa and curated picnics carry additional charges.
Off-site experiences carry additional charges and are subject to seasonal change.
WhataHotel notes the hillside location means you will want a car to get around.
